name: vigiax_alerta
purpose: A flash-flood alert level changed at a station the person signed up for (attention, alert, evacuate, back to normal).
notes: The text must match alert.Text in server/internal/alert/message.go: the service fills the same five values.
{{5}} is a 24-hour time (15:42): with 'p. m.' the sentence would end in two dots.
Buttons carry payloads ack:<station> and false:<station> (server/cmd/vigiax/notify.go).

vars.label: lugar
vars.example: Quebrada La Marinilla, puente de la vereda

vars.label: qué pasa
vars.example: El agua subió 38 cm en 10 minutos y está a 1,6 m.

vars.label: qué hacer
vars.example: Aléjate de la orilla y no cruces el puente.
